neighborhoods.name: Whippany & Cedar Knolls District
neighborhoods.character: Suburban colonials and ranches on generous lots, surrounded by major Fortune 500 corporate headquarters (Bayer, Barclays, MetLife)
neighborhoods.description: Township encompassing Whippany and Cedar Knolls, known for exceptionally low residential property tax rates due to corporate ratables.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Remarkably low certified tax rate (1.986%) with corporate office parks paying over 52% of the local property tax levy.

neighborhoods.name: Cedar Knolls & Troy Hills Section
neighborhoods.character: Suburban family neighborhood with ranches, split-levels, and community elementary schools
neighborhoods.description: Quiet suburban community with proximity to Hanover Community Center and town pool.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Corporate tax payments buffer homeowner taxes from municipal cost inflation.

equityAnalysis.summary: Hanover Township (Whippany) maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Hanover Township (Whippany), homeowners pay an average of $10,387.53 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 7.0% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 87.2%, assessed values average ~87.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 61.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 27.6%, and Morris County claims 11.2%.
